project.name: mike
project.description: Legal document assistant with a Next.js frontend and an Express backend, using Supabase Auth/Postgres, Cloudflare R2-compatible object storage, and Anthropic/Gemini/OpenAI model providers for document drafting, review, and processing.

nodes.name: Identity & Access Control
nodes.summary: Handles who the user is and what they may touch: Supabase email/password auth, per-user profiles with monthly message credits, encrypted bring-your-own LLM API keys, and the ownership-plus-email-sharing rules that gate projects, documents, reviews, and workflows.

businessRules: Every backend request must carry a valid Supabase bearer token; unauthenticated calls are rejected with 401
Resource access is ownership or email-based shared_with membership, checked server-side per request
User LLM API keys are stored AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest, with environment-key fallbacks
Message credits reset on a rolling monthly window and are enforced before any chat turn
crossDomainInteractions: requireAuth middleware fronts every feature router
Credit balance gates assistant and review chat turns
Configured API keys determine which LLM providers and models are selectable

nodes.name: Sign Up & Sign In
nodes.summary: A lawyer creates an account or signs in with Supabase email/password; the backend bootstraps a profile row and the client tracks the session for every later call.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Supabase Auth sign-in/sign-up from the /login and /signup pages

nodes.name: Submit signup
nodes.summary: Create a Supabase account with name and organisation metadata from the signup page, persisting the profile via the API after success.

nodes.name: Sign in
nodes.summary: Authenticate via Supabase email/password sign-in on the login page, redirecting already-authenticated users to the home screen.

nodes.name: Bootstrap profile row
nodes.summary: The backend upserts an empty user_profiles row (ensureProfileRow / loadProfile) so later profile reads succeed.

nodes.name: Track session
nodes.summary: AuthContext fetches the session and listens for auth-state changes, exposing isAuthenticated, loading state, and signOut app-wide.

nodes.name: Load profile context
nodes.summary: UserProfileContext loads display name, organisation, credit usage, tier, and per-provider API-key state from the backend.

nodes.name: Authenticate & Authorize API Requests
nodes.summary: Every API call is authenticated via Supabase bearer token, then authorized against ownership and email-sharing rules before any resource is returned.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Authorization: Bearer header on every backend API request

nodes.name: Attach bearer token
nodes.summary: The mikeApi client attaches the Supabase auth token to every request to the Express backend.

nodes.name: Validate token
nodes.summary: requireAuth verifies the bearer token against Supabase Auth and populates req.userId and req.userEmail, rejecting unauthenticated calls with 401.

nodes.name: Check resource access
nodes.summary: Ownership and shared_with email rules decide the access level for projects, documents, and reviews (checkProjectAccess, ensureDocAccess, ensureReviewAccess).

nodes.name: Filter accessible sets
nodes.summary: List endpoints narrow result sets to accessible ids (listAccessibleProjectIds, filterAccessibleDocumentIds).

nodes.name: Guard owner-only actions
nodes.summary: The frontend mirrors the rules with owner-only guards on shared resources, surfacing an owner-only modal for restricted actions.

nodes.name: Manage API Keys & Model Settings
nodes.summary: Users bring their own Anthropic/Gemini/OpenAI keys, stored encrypted at rest, and pick default models; model availability is gated by which keys are configured.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Account Models page driving the user profile and key endpoints

nodes.name: Enter provider keys
nodes.summary: The account models page offers per-provider key entry with save/remove and a default tabular-model dropdown gated by key availability.

nodes.name: Validate payload
nodes.summary: Profile update fields and provider names are validated, rejecting unknown fields (validateProfilePayload, normalizeApiKeyProvider).

nodes.name: Encrypt and store key
nodes.summary: Keys are AES-256-GCM encrypted and upserted — or deleted when empty — into user_api_keys (saveUserApiKey).

nodes.name: Report key status
nodes.summary: Per-provider status of whether a user key or environment fallback exists is returned without exposing values (getUserApiKeyStatus).

nodes.name: Resolve effective models
nodes.summary: getUserModelSettings resolves validated tabular and title model ids from the profile plus available keys.

nodes.name: Gate model picker
nodes.summary: The frontend only offers models whose provider keys are configured (modelAvailability checks).

nodes.name: Enforce Message Credits
nodes.summary: Usage is metered by monthly message credits that reset on a rolling window, are enforced before each chat turn, and are surfaced in the account UI with a blocking modal when exhausted.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Profile load and chat send paths

nodes.name: Roll credit window
nodes.summary: loadProfile rolls the monthly credit reset window forward when it has expired.

nodes.name: Enforce before streaming
nodes.summary: The streaming chat endpoint enforces the credit limit before running the LLM tool loop.

nodes.name: Show usage
nodes.summary: The account page shows message-credit usage and subscription tier from the profile context.

nodes.name: Block when exhausted
nodes.summary: A credits-exhausted modal blocks further sends once the allowance runs out.

nodes.name: Matters & Document Management
nodes.summary: The system of record for legal work: projects model a matter with client-matter numbers and collaborator sharing; documents are uploaded, converted to PDF, stored in R2 under immutable versions, organized into folder trees, and served back through signed previews and token-gated downloads.

businessRules: Document versions are immutable rows pointing at object-storage paths; the active version is referenced per document
DOCX files are converted to PDF via LibreOffice so every document has a preview artifact
Storage keys are deterministic per user, document, and version
Public downloads require an HMAC-signed, expiring token instead of an authenticated session
Subfolders nest via a self-referencing parent_folder_id; owner-only actions are guarded on shared projects
crossDomainInteractions: Chat, drafting, and tabular review read document bytes from stored versions
Drafting and redlining write their results back as new document versions
Access to matters and documents is decided by the identity domain sharing rules

nodes.name: Create & Share a Matter
nodes.summary: A lawyer creates a project for a matter with a client-matter number, then shares it with collaborators by email so the sharing rules grant them access.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Projects dashboard create modal driving the projects router

nodes.name: Open create modal
nodes.summary: ProjectsOverview lists all projects with search and tab filtering and launches the create-project modal.

nodes.name: Submit new project
nodes.summary: NewProjectModal captures the new matter details for creation.

nodes.name: Persist project
nodes.summary: The projects router creates the project row owned by the user, with client-matter number and visibility flag.

nodes.name: Share by email
nodes.summary: PeopleModal lets the owner add or remove collaborators by email with validation and busy states.

nodes.name: Apply sharing rules
nodes.summary: shared_with membership grants collaborators access through checkProjectAccess on subsequent requests.

nodes.name: Organize Matter Documents
nodes.summary: Inside the project workspace, documents are arranged in a hierarchical folder tree with drag-and-drop uploads and moves, batch upload, and zip download of the matter file.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Project workspace documents tab

nodes.name: Browse folder tree
nodes.summary: ProjectPage drives the documents tab: folder tree, drag-and-drop uploads and moves, version history, and zip download.

nodes.name: Manage subfolders
nodes.summary: Subfolders are created and verified against the project (loadProjectFolder), nesting via parent_folder_id.

nodes.name: Batch upload documents
nodes.summary: Batch uploads run each file through the shared conversion-and-store pipeline (handleDocumentUpload).

nodes.name: Move documents
nodes.summary: Documents move between folders via the project document-move endpoints.

nodes.name: Pick documents anywhere
nodes.summary: FileDirectory and the add-documents modals expose the same matter documents as pickers for chats and reviews across the app.

nodes.name: Ingest & Process a Document
nodes.summary: An uploaded file is size-checked, converted from DOCX to PDF when needed, mined for page count and structure, stored in R2 under deterministic keys, and recorded as a document with its first immutable version.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Multipart upload endpoints on the documents and projects routers

nodes.name: Accept upload
nodes.summary: Multer memory storage enforces the maximum upload size and translates errors into friendly JSON 413/400 responses (singleFileUpload).

nodes.name: Convert DOCX to PDF
nodes.summary: DOCX bytes convert to PDF via LibreOffice after normalizing backslash zip entry names (docxToPdf, normalizeDocxZipPaths).

nodes.name: Extract structure
nodes.summary: Page count and a heading/outline structure tree are extracted from PDF outlines or DOCX text for the document sidebar (countPdfPages, extractStructureTree).

nodes.name: Store in R2
nodes.summary: Original bytes and the converted PDF land in the R2 bucket under deterministic storage keys (uploadFile, storageKey, pdfStorageKey).

nodes.name: Record document rows
nodes.summary: handleDocumentUpload records the document metadata plus an immutable version row pointing at the storage paths.

nodes.name: Track processing status
nodes.summary: The documents table tracks filename, file type, size, page count, parsed structure tree, processing status, and folder placement.

nodes.name: Manage Document Versions
nodes.summary: Each document carries an immutable version history: users list versions, upload new ones, restore older ones, and see change badges driven by the latest assistant-edit version numbers.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Version endpoints on the documents router

nodes.name: List version history
nodes.summary: useDocumentVersions fetches a document’s version history and current version id with bearer auth and a refresh trigger.

nodes.name: Upload new version
nodes.summary: UploadNewVersionModal prefetches the current display name, stages a picked file, and submits the name plus file.

nodes.name: Restore prior version
nodes.summary: The documents router supports version listing, upload, and restore of an earlier version.

nodes.name: Resolve active version
nodes.summary: loadActiveVersion and attachActiveVersionPaths resolve the current version row and batch-attach storage and PDF paths onto document lists.

nodes.name: Badge latest edits
nodes.summary: attachLatestVersionNumbers attaches the highest assistant_edit version number per document for change-badge display.

nodes.name: Preview & Download Securely
nodes.summary: In-app previews use presigned R2 URLs rendered by a pdfjs viewer, while file downloads go through HMAC-signed expiring tokens verified by a public endpoint that streams bytes with sanitized headers.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Signed preview URLs and the public /download endpoint

nodes.name: Issue signed preview
nodes.summary: Presigned R2 GET URLs serve in-app previews, optionally forcing a download filename via response-content-disposition (getSignedUrl).

nodes.name: Render PDF preview
nodes.summary: DocView renders PDF pages to canvases with text layers, wheel/pinch zoom, and current-page tracking.

nodes.name: Sign download token
nodes.summary: signDownload creates an HMAC-SHA256 token embedding storage path, filename, and expiry; buildDownloadUrl wraps it into a /download URL.

nodes.name: Verify token publicly
nodes.summary: The public downloads endpoint verifies the token signature (timing-safe) and expiry without requiring a session (verifyDownload).

nodes.name: Stream with safe headers
nodes.summary: Stored bytes stream back with a sanitized Content-Disposition header carrying quoted and RFC 5987 filenames (buildContentDisposition).

nodes.name: Agentic Assistant Chat
nodes.summary: The flagship feature: a streaming, tool-using LLM conversation over the user’s legal documents. The engine builds document context, runs a multi-turn tool loop against the selected provider, streams deltas and tool events over SSE, and persists transcripts with citation annotations.

businessRules: Message credits are enforced before any streaming turn
Citations arrive in a trailing <CITATIONS> block that is buffered out of the visible output
Prior document-read tool events are replayed into context so the model retains earlier reads
Tool use is restricted to the defined schemas (TOOLS plus project, tabular, and workflow extras)
Only catalog-approved models whose provider key is configured can be used
crossDomainInteractions: Reads document bytes and versions from the matters domain
Invokes drafting and redlining via the generate_document and edit_document tools
Runs workflow prompts loaded from the workflow library
Lends its LLM and citation machinery to tabular review chat

nodes.name: Stream an Assistant Turn
nodes.summary: From the chat input to the persisted transcript: the request is validated, credits enforced, document context built, the multi-turn LLM tool loop streamed over SSE, and the result stored with annotations.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Streaming chat endpoint (SSE) on the chat router

nodes.name: Compose message
nodes.summary: ChatInput supplies the message with attachments, workflow selection, and the model toggle.

nodes.name: Validate request
nodes.summary: parseChatMessages validates and normalizes the payload including attached file descriptors, and chat access is verified (getAccessibleChat).

nodes.name: Enforce credits and models
nodes.summary: Credits are enforced and the user’s effective model and API keys are resolved before streaming begins.

nodes.name: Build document context
nodes.summary: buildDocContext builds the DOC:N doc store from history and current attachments; enrichWithPriorEvents replays earlier doc reads; buildMessages converts the transcript to LLM messages.

nodes.name: Run tool loop
nodes.summary: runLLMStream drives the multi-turn streaming tool loop against the selected provider, emitting deltas, tool events, and final annotations.

nodes.name: Drip-render stream
nodes.summary: useAssistantChat consumes the SSE stream, drip-feeding content for smooth typing while tracking citations and tool events, with cancellation support.

nodes.name: Persist transcript
nodes.summary: Messages persist to chat_messages with citation annotations; hydrateEditStatuses later refreshes edit annotation statuses and version numbers.

nodes.name: Execute Document Tools
nodes.summary: The model works on real documents through a fixed toolset: reading cached document text, searching for quotes, and invoking project, tabular, and workflow extras, with progress streamed to the client.

domainMeta.entryPoint: LLM tool_use events emitted during a chat turn

nodes.name: Dispatch tool call
nodes.summary: runToolCalls is the dispatch hub executing every chat tool call and streaming progress events to the client.

nodes.name: Resolve doc labels
nodes.summary: Raw model-provided doc ids resolve to canonical DOC:N labels and document UUIDs (resolveDoc, resolveDocLabel).

nodes.name: Read document
nodes.summary: readDocumentContent loads and caches a document’s text, sniffing PDF/DOCX/binary content and emitting doc-read progress; extractPdfText adds [Page N] markers.

nodes.name: Find in document
nodes.summary: findInDocumentContent searches whitespace-normalized text for a quote and streams back match contexts with page hints (normalizeWithMap).

nodes.name: Run feature extras
nodes.summary: Project, tabular, and workflow extra tools execute when their schemas are enabled (PROJECT_EXTRA_TOOLS, TABULAR_TOOLS, WORKFLOW_TOOLS).

nodes.name: Return results to model
nodes.summary: Tool results feed back into the streaming loop for the next model turn until the answer completes.

nodes.name: Chat Across a Whole Matter
nodes.summary: Project chat puts every ready document of a matter into context: access is validated, the project-wide doc store built with subfolder paths, and the tool loop streamed with project chat persistence.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Project-scoped streaming chat endpoint

nodes.name: Open project chat
nodes.summary: The project workspace assistant tab hosts conversations scoped to the matter.

nodes.name: Validate project access
nodes.summary: The project chat endpoint validates project access before building context or streaming.

nodes.name: Build project context
nodes.summary: buildProjectDocContext loads every ready document in the project into the doc store, resolving subfolder paths.

nodes.name: Stream with project tools
nodes.summary: The LLM tool loop streams with the project extras enabled for matter-wide work.

nodes.name: Persist project chat
nodes.summary: Chat history persists scoped to the project for the workspace’s chats tab.

nodes.name: Route a Model to Its Provider
nodes.summary: A classic adapter pattern hides three vendors behind one contract: the model id resolves against a tiered catalog, dispatches to the Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI adapter, and tool schemas convert to each provider’s native shape.

domainMeta.entryPoint: streamChatWithTools and completeText calls from chat and review features

nodes.name: Pick model
nodes.summary: The model toggle in the chat input offers models allowed by provider-key availability.

nodes.name: Resolve catalog entry
nodes.summary: The model catalog validates allowed Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI ids per capability tier and resolves the provider and defaults.

nodes.name: Dispatch to adapter
nodes.summary: The provider router facade dispatches streamChatWithTools and completeText to the matching adapter based on the model id.

nodes.name: Convert tool schemas
nodes.summary: Provider-neutral tool definitions convert into native Claude and Gemini schemas, stripping JSON Schema fields Gemini rejects.

nodes.name: Drive provider stream
nodes.summary: Each adapter drives its provider’s streaming loop with reasoning and content callbacks — Claude SDK, Gemini function-calling parts, or OpenAI Responses SSE.

nodes.name: Ground Answers in Citations
nodes.summary: Answers stay verifiable: the citation block is buffered out of the visible stream, parsed and normalized into annotations, rendered in a citation side panel, and clicking a citation highlights the exact quote in the source document.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Trailing <CITATIONS> block in model output

nodes.name: Buffer citation block
nodes.summary: runLLMStream buffers the citation block out of the visible streamed output.

nodes.name: Parse citations
nodes.summary: parseCitations extracts the trailing <CITATIONS> JSON; normalizeCitation coerces marker/ref/page/quote variants into the canonical shape.

nodes.name: Persist annotations
nodes.summary: extractAnnotations converts parsed citations and document-edit events into message annotation records stored with the transcript.

nodes.name: Show citation panel
nodes.summary: ChatView renders the message list and manages side-panel tabs for citations, documents, and edits.

nodes.name: Jump to source
nodes.summary: Citation quotes highlight in the rendered document with scroll-to-match (DocView highlights via highlightQuote/highlightDocxQuote).

nodes.name: Document Drafting & Redlining
nodes.summary: Turns the assistant into a drafting colleague: it generates styled legal DOCX documents from scratch and proposes edits to existing documents as genuine Word tracked changes (w:ins/w:del), which the lawyer accepts or rejects with full version history.

businessRules: Edits are applied as Word tracked changes, never silent rewrites
Each edit must anchor to a unique occurrence in normalized paragraph text, using before/after context to disambiguate
New tracked-change ids continue from the highest existing id in the document
Accepting or rejecting a change re-serializes the DOCX and refreshes the PDF preview
Every proposed edit is recorded in document_edits with accept/reject status
crossDomainInteractions: Triggered from assistant chat via the generate_document and edit_document tools
Generated drafts and edit results are stored as new document versions in the matters domain

nodes.name: Generate a Legal Document
nodes.summary: The model drafts a complete legal document: structured sections become a styled DOCX with legal numbering and signature blocks, uploaded to storage and recorded as a first-class document.

domainMeta.entryPoint: generate_document tool call in a chat turn

nodes.name: Invoke generate tool
nodes.summary: The model calls the generate_document tool with structured sections drawn from the conversation.

nodes.name: Build styled DOCX
nodes.summary: generateDocx renders headings, legal numbering, tables, and signature blocks into a styled legal DOCX.

nodes.name: Upload generated file
nodes.summary: The file uploads to object storage under the assistant-generated document key (generatedDocKey).

nodes.name: Record document and version
nodes.summary: Document and version rows are recorded so the draft behaves like any uploaded document.

nodes.name: Preview in chat
nodes.summary: The new draft surfaces through the chat’s document side panel for immediate preview.

nodes.name: Propose Tracked Edits
nodes.summary: The assistant redlines a document like a colleague using Track Changes: find/replace edits are anchored in normalized paragraph text, rewritten as w:ins/w:del runs preserving formatting, and saved as a new assistant_edit version.

domainMeta.entryPoint: edit_document tool call in a chat turn

nodes.name: Invoke edit tool
nodes.summary: The model calls the edit_document tool with find/replace edits and surrounding context.

nodes.name: Load current bytes
nodes.summary: loadCurrentVersionBytes downloads the document’s active version from object storage.

nodes.name: Anchor each edit
nodes.summary: findUniqueAnchor locates a unique occurrence in whitespace- and punctuation-normalized paragraph text, mapped back to original offsets (normalizeWs, mapNormRangeToOriginal).

nodes.name: Rewrite runs as tracked changes
nodes.summary: applyTrackedEdits and reconstructParagraph emit normal, w:del, and w:ins runs preserving run formatting, with fresh tracked ids continuing from maxTrackedId.

nodes.name: Save edit version
nodes.summary: runEditDocument stores the result as a new assistant_edit version and records document_edits rows with per-edit errors handled.

nodes.name: Show edit cards
nodes.summary: Per-change metadata streams back as edit events rendered as accept/reject cards in the conversation.

nodes.name: Accept or Reject Edits
nodes.summary: The lawyer disposes of each proposed change: the UI updates optimistically, the OOXML engine accepts or rejects the w:ins/w:del elements, a refreshed version and PDF are uploaded, and statuses sync back into the chat.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Edit accept/reject endpoint on the documents router

nodes.name: Choose accept or reject
nodes.summary: EditCard presents each AI-proposed change with accept and reject actions.

nodes.name: Optimistic DOM update
nodes.summary: applyOptimisticResolution optimistically hides or keeps tracked-change DOM nodes in the rendered DOCX before the backend confirms.

nodes.name: Resolve in OOXML
nodes.summary: resolveTrackedChange walks the XML tree accepting or rejecting w:ins/w:del elements for the target ids and re-serializes the DOCX zip (resolveInTree).

nodes.name: Refresh version and PDF
nodes.summary: handleEditResolution rewrites the DOCX, uploading a refreshed version and converted PDF.

nodes.name: Update edit status
nodes.summary: document_edits status rows update to reflect the accept/reject outcome.

nodes.name: Sync chat annotations
nodes.summary: hydrateEditStatuses refreshes document-edit annotation statuses and version numbers in stored chat messages.

nodes.name: Tabular Multi-Document Review
nodes.summary: Spreadsheet-style diligence across many documents at once: each row is a document and each column an extraction question; LLM-generated cells stream into the grid with citations, a citation-aware chat sits over the same review, and results export to Excel.

businessRules: Each cell carries citations and a generation status, keyed by document and column index
Cell content parses as a JSON verdict (summary/value/status), tolerating legacy string formats
Review access is via ownership, the review share list, or the parent project’s rules
Reviews persist column configuration, selected document ids, and an optional source workflow
crossDomainInteractions: Pulls documents and stored text from the matters domain
Reuses the multi-provider LLM layer and citation machinery from assistant chat
Can be seeded from a tabular workflow template

nodes.name: Create a Tabular Review
nodes.summary: A reviewer assembles a review from a title, optional project and workflow template, a set of documents, and a column configuration, then lands in the streaming grid.

domainMeta.entryPoint: New tabular review modal driving the tabular router

nodes.name: Configure review
nodes.summary: AddNewTRModal walks through title input plus optional project and workflow-template dropdowns.

nodes.name: Select documents
nodes.summary: Documents are multi-selected via FileDirectory or uploaded standalone or into the project.

nodes.name: Define columns
nodes.summary: Columns come from presets, a workflow template, or the add-column modal.

nodes.name: Persist review
nodes.summary: The tabular_reviews row stores column configuration, selected document ids, source workflow, practice area, and a shared_with list.

nodes.name: Open review grid
nodes.summary: TabularReviewView orchestrates documents, columns, and cells with side panels and drag-drop document management.

nodes.name: Generate Review Cells
nodes.summary: Document text is extracted as markdown, then answered column-by-column — one cell at a time or a whole row in a single streaming call — with results streamed into the grid and persisted with citations.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Cell and row generation endpoints on the tabular router

nodes.name: Extract document text
nodes.summary: Page-delimited markdown-ish text extracts from PDFs via pdfjs and from DOCX via mammoth (extractPdfMarkdown, extractDocxMarkdown).

nodes.name: Query single cell
nodes.summary: queryTabularCell runs one column prompt against one document’s text via completeText and parses the JSON cell verdict.

nodes.name: Stream whole row
nodes.summary: queryTabularAllColumns streams one LLM call answering every column for a document, parsing line-delimited JSON cell results as they arrive.

nodes.name: Stream into grid
nodes.summary: Cells stream into the spreadsheet with per-cell generation status rendered in place.

nodes.name: Persist cells
nodes.summary: Generated contents persist to tabular_cells keyed by document and column index, carrying citations and status.

nodes.name: Refine columns and rerun
nodes.summary: Column CRUD and the edit-column menu let reviewers refine extraction questions and regenerate.

nodes.name: Chat Over a Review
nodes.summary: A citation-aware chat sits beside the grid: the review renders as a markdown table for context, responses stream with citations mapped back to review documents, and sessions persist with auto-generated titles.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Review chat endpoints (SSE) on the tabular router

nodes.name: Open chat panel
nodes.summary: TRChatPanel is a resizable side panel streaming SSE responses with drip-rendered text, reasoning and doc-read blocks, and inline citations.

nodes.name: Render grid context
nodes.summary: buildTabularContext renders the review grid — columns, rows, cell summaries — as a markdown table for chat context.

nodes.name: Compose review messages
nodes.summary: buildTabularMessages builds the review-chat LLM messages including the column/row map of the grid.

nodes.name: Map citations to documents
nodes.summary: extractTabularAnnotations converts parsed citations into annotation records mapped to review documents.

nodes.name: Persist review chat
nodes.summary: Sessions and messages persist to tabular_review_chats and tabular_review_chat_messages with citation annotations.

nodes.name: Auto-title chat

nodes.name: Export a Review to Excel
nodes.summary: The finished grid leaves the app as a clean .xlsx: a document-by-column grid is built, citation and pill markup stripped, and an exceljs workbook downloaded in the browser.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Export action on the tabular review screen

nodes.name: Build export grid
nodes.summary: The exporter builds a document-by-column grid from the review contents.

nodes.name: Strip markup
nodes.summary: Citation and pill markup is stripped from cell text for clean spreadsheet values.

nodes.name: Write workbook
nodes.summary: exceljs writes the .xlsx workbook and the filename is sanitized.

nodes.name: Download blob
nodes.summary: The browser triggers a blob download of the finished workbook.

nodes.name: Workflow Template Library
nodes.summary: Reusable legal expertise as prompts: chat- and tabular-typed workflow templates with practice areas, built-in firm templates, email-based sharing with edit permissions, and launch points that drop a workflow into an assistant chat or spawn a whole tabular review.

businessRules: System (built-in) workflows cannot be edited
Sharing is granted by email with an optional edit-permission flag
Users can hide system or shared workflows without deleting them
A workflow is typed as chat or tabular, carrying a markdown prompt or a column config
crossDomainInteractions: Chat workflows inject reusable prompts into assistant runs via the workflow tools
Tabular workflows seed the column configuration of new reviews

nodes.name: Author Workflow Templates
nodes.summary: Users browse the library of built-in and custom workflows, create or edit templates with a type, practice area, and prompt or column content, with system templates protected from edits.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Workflows library page driving the workflows router CRUD

nodes.name: Browse library
nodes.summary: WorkflowList shows built-in and user workflows with search, practice filtering, hide/unhide, and edit/delete actions.

nodes.name: Create or edit
nodes.summary: NewWorkflowModal toggles assistant/tabular type, practice-area selection with a custom option, and prompt or column content.

nodes.name: Edit prompt and columns
nodes.summary: The prompt editor and column modals refine the template body and column configuration.

nodes.name: Persist template
nodes.summary: The workflows table stores the markdown prompt, column config, practice area, and a system-template flag.

nodes.name: Guard system templates
nodes.summary: handleWorkflowUpdate applies validated updates for owners or edit-permitted sharers, refusing system workflows.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Share workflow modal driving the workflow share endpoints

nodes.name: Enter collaborator emails
nodes.summary: ShareWorkflowModal collects recipient emails for the share grant.

nodes.name: Record share grant
nodes.summary: workflow_shares stores the email-based grant with an optional edit-permission flag.

nodes.name: Resolve access on request
nodes.summary: resolveWorkflowAccess determines ownership or share-based access and edit rights, decorating rows via withWorkflowAccess.

nodes.name: Show sharer names
nodes.summary: loadSharerNames resolves sharer display names from user_profiles, falling back to auth admin email lookups.

nodes.name: List shared workflows
nodes.summary: Shared templates appear in the recipient’s library alongside their own and the built-ins.

nodes.name: Launch a Workflow
nodes.summary: A workflow becomes work: pickers in the chat input and review-creation modal let users select a template, whose prompt drives the assistant turn or whose columns seed a new tabular review.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Workflow pickers in the chat input and review-creation modal

nodes.name: Pick workflow
nodes.summary: AssistantWorkflowModal merges built-ins with custom workflows fetched from the API, with search filtering and a preview pane.

nodes.name: Load workflow store
nodes.summary: buildWorkflowStore loads owned and shared workflow prompts into the store backing the chat workflow tools.

nodes.summary: A chat workflow’s prompt drives the assistant turn through the workflow tools (WORKFLOW_TOOLS).

nodes.name: Seed tabular review
nodes.summary: A tabular workflow selected at review creation seeds the new review’s column configuration.

edges.description: requireAuth and the ownership/shared_with email rules gate every project and document operation.
Message credits are enforced before each streaming turn, and bring-your-own API keys determine which models are selectable.
Review access resolves via ownership, the review share list, or the parent project’s sharing rules.
Workflow access combines ownership with email share grants and per-share edit permissions.
Chat tools read document text from stored versions; project chat builds its context from every ready matter document.
The generate_document and edit_document tool calls invoke the drafting and tracked-change engines.
Generated drafts and tracked-edit results are uploaded to R2 and recorded as new document versions.
Reviews select matter or standalone documents and extract text from their stored bytes.
Cell generation and review chat reuse the multi-provider LLM layer and the citation machinery.
Chat workflows inject reusable prompts into assistant runs via the workflow tools.
Tabular workflow templates seed the column configuration of new reviews.
